aviation_operations.title: ✈️ Commercial Aviation Dispatch & Diversion
aviation_operations.summary: Supervises commercial flight safety when deteriorating weather at the destination airport conflicts with finite emergency fuel reserves.
aviation_operations.edge_case: Terminal convective storms and gusting crosswinds active while projected alternate fuel reserve margin is near minimum legal exhaustion.
plain_telemetry: Alternate Fuel Reserve Margin
Minutes of fuel remaining above the mandatory legal minimum. Near zero means the aircraft cannot hold in the air much longer.
Destination Crosswind Velocity
Wind blowing perpendicular to the runway. Higher knots force severe crab angles and risk runway excursion.
Time to Alternate Field
Flight duration to the backup diversion airport if the current approach is abandoned.
aviation_operations.plain_outputs: Categorizes tactical action (Continue Approach, Divert to Alternate, or ATC Emergency Priority), assigns binary mandatory safety risk, and scores operational emergency severity (0 to 4).

choices.continue_approach: Maintain planned terminal approach with monitored holding.
choices.divert_alternate: Execute tactical diversion to designated alternate airport.
choices.emergency_priority: Declare fuel priority / emergency coordination with ATC.

aviation_operations.unsafe_prompt: Does the combined crosswind and marginal alternate fuel reserve warrant an immediate mandatory diversion?
aviation_operations.interlock: FAA Part 121 legal fuel reserves, aircraft limitations, and captain command authority strictly govern physical diversions.
aviation_operations.llm_failure: Generative models produce contradictory holding vs. diversion directives across runs when margins are near zero.

robot_trajectory.title: 🤖 Autonomous Trajectory Safety Gate
robot_trajectory.summary: Monitors mobile robot navigation corridors in real time to stop or reroute the machine before high-speed physical collisions occur.
robot_trajectory.edge_case: An obstacle enters the robot stopping corridor while localization uncertainty increases.
plain_telemetry: Time to Collision
Seconds remaining at current speed before impact if neither the obstacle nor robot changes course.
Required Stopping Time
Time in seconds required for the physical brakes/motors to bring the robot to a complete halt.
Localization Uncertainty (Sigma)
How unsure the robot's onboard sensors are about its own physical GPS/LiDAR coordinates.
robot_trajectory.plain_outputs: Routes motion supervision (Proceed, Replan Path, Emergency Protective Stop, or Manual Review), flags immediate collision breach risk, and rates physical hazard severity.
robot_trajectory.unsafe_prompt: Would maintaining the current trajectory create an unacceptable collision margin?
robot_trajectory.interlock: Real-time safety hardware controllers override model commands when stopping time exceeds collision envelope.
robot_trajectory.llm_failure: Autoregressive streaming introduces variable token latency and produces inconsistent motion directives.

gnss_integrity.title: 🛰️ Electronic Warfare & GNSS Integrity
gnss_integrity.summary: Detects hostile electronic jamming and GPS spoofing attacks where fake navigation signals attempt to deceive autonomous aircraft or maritime vessels.
gnss_integrity.edge_case: GNSS signal strength remains strong while inertial navigation disagrees with GNSS position.
plain_telemetry: GNSS C/N0 Drop
Signal carrier power drop. Normal drops mean poor line of sight; low drop with position error strongly implies spoofing.
GNSS / INS Position Delta
Physical distance discrepancy between satellite GPS coordinates and onboard internal inertial gyroscope/accelerometer readings.
RF Noise Floor Rise
Background electromagnetic noise. A massive spike signals active brute-force RF jamming.
gnss_integrity.plain_outputs: Classifies RF threat status (Nominal, Natural Fading, Active Jamming, Malicious Spoofing), sets untrusted navigation flag, and rates electronic integrity compromise severity.

choices.fading: Signal attenuation from multipath or shadowing.
choices.jamming: High RF noise floor indicating intentional jamming.
choices.suspected_spoofing: Navigation disagreement despite healthy RF floor (spoofing indicator).
choices.indeterminate: Telemetry insufficient to distinguish root causes.

gnss_integrity.unsafe_prompt: Does the telemetry warrant treating GNSS position as compromised until verified?
gnss_integrity.interlock: Kalman filters and INS voting interlocks govern fallback; model outputs never establish trusted coordinates.
gnss_integrity.llm_failure: Generative models frequently fail to detect spoofing when raw signal strength metrics remain deceptively strong.

lob_risk.title: 📈 High-Frequency Limit Order Book Risk
lob_risk.summary: Protects algorithmic market makers from catastrophic flash-crashes by managing quote cancellations when exchange liquidity evaporates.
lob_risk.edge_case: Displayed liquidity collapses and spreads widen while market-data feed becomes stale.
plain_telemetry: Market Data Feed Staleness
Age of exchange incoming price packets in milliseconds. Old data means the algorithm is blind to recent order executions.
Bid-Ask Spread
The gap between the highest price buyers offer and lowest price sellers accept. Wide gaps mean extreme trading risk.
Top-of-Book Depth Collapse
Percentage of the immediate buying/selling cushion that suddenly disappeared. 80%+ means any trade will cause severe price slippage.
lob_risk.plain_outputs: Determines quoting posture (Normal, Spread Widening / Risk Reduction, Active Quote Cancellation, Immediate Strategy Kill-Switch Halt), checks unsafe market flag, and scores liquidity disruption severity.

choices.normal: Continue quoting within standard risk envelopes.
choices.reduce_risk: Widen quotation spreads and trim inventory risk.
choices.cancel_review: Cancel active limit orders pending liquidity recovery.
choices.strategy_halt: Trigger strategy kill-switch and suspend quoting.

lob_risk.unsafe_prompt: Is continued live quoting unsafe without market-data and liquidity revalidation?
lob_risk.interlock: Exchange connectivity limits, stale-feed timers, and hardware kill-switches remain deterministic.
lob_risk.llm_failure: Token streaming cannot meet execution deadlines and hallucinates non-existent order depth.

gpu_thermal.title: ⚡ AI Cluster & Thermal Incident
gpu_thermal.summary: Detects early cooling failure in multi-million dollar AI training clusters to throttle or evacuate compute loads before permanent hardware damage occurs.
gpu_thermal.edge_case: GPU hotspot temperature remains acceptable briefly despite severe cooling-flow degradation.
plain_telemetry: GPU Hotspot Temp
Peak instantaneous silicon temperature on the graphics processor die.
Coolant Flow / Nominal
Mass flow rate of liquid coolant circulating through the compute rack. Drops below 30% precede rapid thermal runaway.
Rack Inlet Temp
Ambient server room air intake temperature entering the chassis.
gpu_thermal.plain_outputs: Supervises thermal mitigation (Nominal Monitor, Frequency Throttling, Workload Migration, Emergency Node Shutdown), checks unsafe compute flag, and scores thermal incident severity.

choices.throttle_review: Apply dynamic frequency throttling to compute nodes.
choices.migrate_review: Migrate active AI training workloads to redundant racks.
choices.isolate_escalate: Isolate cooling loop and execute emergency node shutdown.

gpu_thermal.unsafe_prompt: Is continued full-load compute unsafe without independent cooling verification?
gpu_thermal.interlock: BMC and hardware thermal fuses cut power automatically; AI has zero direct power control.
gpu_thermal.llm_failure: Prose models focus on current temperature and miss the drop in cooling flow preceding thermal runaway.

macro_shock.title: 📉 S&P 500 Macro Volatility Shock
macro_shock.summary: Assesses systemic capital market dislocation across sovereign bonds and equities to adjust asset manager hedging allocations.
macro_shock.edge_case: Unscheduled rate decision coincides with high-volume equity liquidation.
plain_telemetry: VIX Spot Level
The 'Wall Street Fear Gauge' reflecting expected 30-day market volatility. Above 35 indicates active crisis conditions.
2Y/10Y Yield Spread
Yield inversion between short-term and long-term US Treasury bonds. Negative values signal severe economic recession expectations.
HY Spread Expansion
High-Yield corporate credit spread widening in basis points. Large surges mean corporate debt default fears are spiking.
macro_shock.plain_outputs: Directs macro treasury risk response (Nominal Monitoring, Dynamic Delta Hedging, Collateral Deleveraging), checks systemic failure flag, and rates systemic tail-risk severity.

choices.nominal_monitoring: Standard portfolio margin and hedge parameters.
choices.delta_hedging: Execute dynamic equity delta hedging protocol.

macro_shock.unsafe_prompt: Does the macro velocity indicate systemic market liquidity failure?
macro_shock.interlock: Exchange circuit breakers and internal margin limits override model recommendations.
macro_shock.llm_failure: Autoregressive generation cannot output millisecond hedging actions and produces narrative justification instead of deterministic probability.

rf_spectrum.title: 📡 Satellite RF Spectrum Degradation
rf_spectrum.summary: Maintains deep-space and low-Earth-orbit communication links by automatically adapting modulation schemes during heavy atmospheric interference.
rf_spectrum.edge_case: Downlink signal attenuation during dense atmospheric ionization and adjacent band interference.
plain_telemetry: Carrier-to-Noise Ratio (C/N0)
Raw signal clarity vs background noise in decibels. Low values cause dropped communication frames.
Adjacent Channel Leakage
Interference leaking into the downlink from nearby frequency bands.
Doppler Shift Velocity
Frequency distortion caused by the satellite moving at thousands of kilometers per hour relative to the ground receiver.
rf_spectrum.plain_outputs: Selects RF link optimization (Maintain Nominal Link, Adaptive Low-Order Coding Fallback, Switch to Redundant Carrier), evaluates link loss risk, and scores RF degradation severity.

choices.nominal_link: Maintain current modulation and forward error correction (FEC).
choices.adaptive_coding: Downgrade modulation order (QPSK) to preserve link lock.
choices.carrier_failover: Switch downlink to redundant S-band transponder.

rf_spectrum.unsafe_prompt: Is the satellite downlink in imminent danger of complete telemetry loss?
rf_spectrum.interlock: Phase-locked loops (PLL) and hardware carrier tracking enforce physical demodulation limits.
rf_spectrum.llm_failure: Generative LLMs confuse dB logarithmic scales with linear percentages.
